claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert sample counts and no demo storage keys

claim: Works without an account
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with no cookies or stored identity; assert the complete report is ready

claim: Saves a standalone reader, linked original EML files, hashes, and a JSON manifest in one ZIP
where: How it works, README, export result
sandbox: sample archive; download ZIP and inspect reader links, archive paths, counts, and hashes

claim: Imports MBOX and counts messages and attachments
where: How it works, README, source picker
sandbox: synthetic MBOX in the demo; assert four messages and two extracted attachments in the exported ZIP

claim: Imports Maildir folders and preserves their names
where: How it works, README, source picker
sandbox: synthetic EML file with a Maildir cur path; assert source type and folder name

claim: Flags duplicate messages
sandbox: two synthetic EML files with one Message-ID; assert a duplicate issue in the report model

claim: Mail stays on this computer
sandbox: fresh browser context; export demo and a unique local EML, then assert every request is a same-origin GET

claim: The app does not use analytics
sandbox: fresh browser context across home, privacy, and demo export; assert no data requests, external origins, non-GET requests, or cookies

claim: A $19 one-time license saves up to 50 export receipts on this computer
sandbox: fresh browser context with intercepted recorded valid verification response; restore, export one EML, and assert the local receipt

claim: The demo works offline after its first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for service worker, go offline, reload, and assert report

claim: Exports original EML bytes
sandbox: ISO-8859-1 8bit EML ending in 0xe9; compare source and exported EML SHA-256

claim: Exports RFC 2231 and quoted-printable attachments
sandbox: multipart fixture; assert decoded filename, bytes, manifest path, and reader link

claim: Keeps valid unnamed, RFC 2231 continued-name, and zero-byte attachments
sandbox: fresh /app multipart import; inspect the ZIP and manifest for three attachments, including an empty file with its SHA-256

claim: The standalone reader keeps complete message text
sandbox: message body longer than 100,000 characters; assert the reader and original EML contain the final legal-hold marker

claim: Reports malformed attachment encoding instead of silently exporting it
sandbox: invalid base64 fixture; assert anomaly and no attachment file

claim: Rejects empty EML files
sandbox: empty .eml File; assert a clear rejection

claim: IMAP reports folders it cannot open
sandbox: scripted IMAP peer denies a folder; assert its read-only failure remains in the import payload

claim: IMAP passwords are used for the connection and are not stored
sandbox: inspect browser and Rust source paths; assert no credential persistence API is used

claim: Demo controls are at least 44 pixels tall
sandbox: 390px browser; measure both demo controls

claim: One-line installers verify SHA-256 checksums
sandbox: read shipped POSIX and PowerShell installers; assert both perform SHA-256 verification before install
